name: OXP Breaking News Ticker
author: oxymaster

sections.description:
OXP Breaking News Ticker builds scrolling news bars for WordPress: a breaking news strip across the header, a quieter marquee of latest posts in the footer, whatever the site needs. You set each one up in the admin and place it with the Gutenberg block or a shortcode.

Headlines are typed by hand or pulled from your own posts. Pick a post type, filter it by taxonomy, term or keyword, and load the matches in one click. They are saved as a snapshot, so the ticker runs no database queries when somebody visits.

Every ticker is a saved preset: edit it once and every page it appears on follows. Switch any of them on or off from the list with a single click, no page reload and no code.

Features

Content

  • Add news items manually (title + URL + optional date) and reorder them with drag and drop.
  • Optional display date per item: items loaded from posts capture their publication date, manual items take the date you pick. Choose where it sits (before or after the headline), how it reads (site format, short, day and month, long, relative, or your own pattern), and give it its own typography and opacity.
  • Dynamic items (Premium): add a WP Query as an item and it stays live. Instead of freezing the posts it finds, the ticker stores the search and runs it again on every render, so a new post appears on its own and a deleted one goes. Pick the post type, filter by taxonomy, terms or keyword, choose how many and in what order. It sits wherever you drag it, between your hand-written headlines, and each result brings its own title, link and publication date. The editor shows how many posts the query matches right now, and says so plainly when the answer is none.
  • Dynamic items stay fresh behind a page cache. A cached page keeps the headlines it was built with; the ticker notices when the page it is on is not fresh and quietly fetches the current ones. No cache plugin integration and nothing to configure.
  • Schedule any item (Premium): a clock on the item row opens “from” and “until”, both optional, both inclusive, and each with an optional time of day. A start alone shows the item from then on, an end alone shows it until then. A scheduled item adds one thin line to its row naming the state (running, upcoming, past) and the dates, in traffic-light colour.
  • “Load from posts” snapshot picker: browse any post type, filter by taxonomy and terms, search by keyword, and load matching posts as items in one click. Each post is captured as a snapshot, so there are no database queries at render time and no performance cost for your visitors.
  • Link options per ticker: open in new tab; custom rel attribute (Premium).
  • Display limit: show only the first N items from a longer list (Premium).
  • Per-ticker internal description (Premium).
  • JSON import / export of tickers from the list screen (all or selected).
  • The ticker list shows each ticker as it really looks: a live miniature of the bar with its own theme, palette, label and first headline, beside its item count, its shortcode and an on/off switch. Tickers that are switched off are greyed out, so you can see at a glance what is running on the site.

Design

  • Seven structural themes. Four are free: Classic, Modern, Breaking News and Minimalist. Three are Premium and each paints a texture of its own across the bar, tinted from the palette rather than in a colour of its own:
    • Comic: impact rays behind the label, halftone shading across the bar, and a skewed label pasted onto the corner with a hard ink shadow.
    • Capsule: one soft capsule, fully rounded end to end, with a lit rim and light pooling gently along the bar.
    • Galaxy: nebula clouds and filaments in the palette’s own colours, over a field of stars.
  • Thirteen hand-tuned color palettes, plus a fully custom palette with gradients. The Premium palettes carry a soft gradient of their own on the bar and on the label; the free ones are flat. Six are free (Breaking, Aurora, Coffee, Editorial, Arctic and Caribbean) and seven are Premium (Forest, Sunset, Blossom, Cobalt, Graphite, Gold and Neon), chosen to cover the accent colors the free six leave out. The custom palette is free.
  • Every palette works in a dark and a light mode, switchable per ticker: the mode sets the background, the headline text, and the control buttons (hover included), while the palette keeps its accent color.
  • Color fields accept anything CSS does: hex (#1a1a2e), named colors (red, orange, rebeccapurple), rgb()/rgba() and hsl()/hsla(), in the old comma syntax or the modern one. Paste what your design tool copied.
  • Independent typography for news text, label, and item date: font family, weight, size, style, decoration, and text transform (plus opacity for the date).
  • Google Fonts are self-hosted at save time, so no request reaches a Google server while somebody is browsing your site (GDPR-compliant).
  • Show or hide individual elements per ticker: previous/next buttons, play-pause toggle, label pulse dot, per-headline pulse dot, and label.
  • Swap the label’s pulse dot for one of twenty-two icons (Premium): megaphone, globe, sparkle, speech bubble, envelope, bell, flame, lightning and more. The icon takes the pulse dot’s colour.
  • Optional edge fade: headlines fade out at the sides of the news area.
  • Configurable height and max-width.

Behavior

  • Three movement modes: Slide (one headline at a time), Fade (crossfade in place),
    and Continuous (endless marquee strip with configurable scroll speed).
  • Scroll direction: left, right, up, or down (left/right in Continuous mode).
  • Speed, easing, inter-item delay, and scroll offset.
  • Autoplay, loop, pause on hover or tap, pause when the browser tab loses focus.
  • Optional blinking pulse dot before each headline.

Placing the ticker

  • Shortcode [oxpbnt_ticker id="X"], with one-click copy from the ticker list and from the editor.
  • Native Gutenberg block: search for “Breaking News Ticker”, pick a saved ticker from the selector, and see it previewed right on the canvas. If you have none yet, the block offers a “Create your first ticker” button. Supports wide and full alignment.
  • Elementor widget (Premium): “Breaking News Ticker”, under the Oxypage category. Pick a saved ticker and it renders live on the canvas.
  • Oxygen Builder element (Premium): “Breaking News Ticker”, under the Oxypage category, for Oxygen 6 and up.
  • Divi, Beaver Builder and Bricks are on the way.
  • All of them point at the same saved ticker, so editing it updates every place it was inserted.
  • Settings lists every editor found on your site and lets you turn each one on or off. The shortcode is always available; unchecking the block removes it from the inserter without touching pages that already use it.

Accessibility and performance

  • ARIA live regions, keyboard navigation, and prefers-reduced-motion support.
  • Assets load only on pages that contain a ticker, or globally. Your choice, in Settings.
  • AJAX activation toggle from the ticker list.
  • Optional clean uninstall that removes all plugin data.

External services

This plugin connects to Freemius, the service that handles licensing, payments and Premium updates for OXP Breaking News Ticker. Freemius is only contacted in the situations listed below.

When you activate the plugin. You are shown an opt-in screen. Nothing is sent until you accept it, and you can skip it: the plugin works exactly the same either way. If you accept, your WordPress user name and email address, the site URL and basic environment data (WordPress version, PHP version, plugin version, site language and time zone) are sent so the site can be registered and so you can be notified of security and update releases.

When you use a Premium license. The license key and the site URL are sent each time the license is activated, deactivated, validated or renewed, and whenever WordPress checks for an update of the Premium version. This is what makes the license work on your site and what delivers the paid updates.

When you deactivate the plugin. An optional feedback form may be shown. Sending it is voluntary, and nothing is sent if you close it.

The free version on wordpress.org contacts Freemius only if you opted in, or if you activate a license on it.

This service is provided by Freemius, Inc. Terms of service: https://freemius.com/terms/ Privacy policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the oxp-breaking-news-ticker folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to “OXP Tickers” → “New Ticker”, configure it, and save.
  4. Add the “Breaking News Ticker” block to any post or page and pick your ticker, or copy the shortcode (e.g. [oxpbnt_ticker id="123"]) and paste it wherever you want.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know how to code?

No. Everything is configured from the WordPress admin: content, behavior, colors, and typography. Place the ticker anywhere using the Gutenberg block or the generated shortcode. No PHP, no CSS.

How do I insert a ticker into a page?

Two ways in the free plan. In the block editor, add the “Breaking News Ticker” block and choose one of your saved tickers from the selector; the block previews it on the canvas. Anywhere else (classic editor, text widgets, page builders) paste the shortcode shown in the ticker list, e.g. [oxpbnt_ticker id="123"]. Premium adds a native Elementor widget and a native Oxygen Builder element.

Can I create more than one ticker?

Yes. Each ticker is an independent preset. The free plan supports up to 3 tickers with 20 items each. Premium removes both limits.

What does Premium include, and how do the plans differ?

Every Premium plan unlocks exactly the same features: unlimited tickers and items, the Premium themes and palettes, dynamic WP Query items, item scheduling, the label icons, the Elementor and Oxygen Builder integrations and the advanced link and display options. The plans differ only in how many sites one license can be activated on, and for how long you receive updates and support. You can see them, and activate a license you already own, under “OXP Tickers” in your WordPress admin.

I bought a license. How do I activate it?

In your WordPress admin, go to “OXP Tickers” and open the Account screen, then enter the license key you received by email. The same screen deactivates the license if you need to move it to another site. Your license is also what delivers automatic updates of the Premium version: once activated, new versions arrive in the Plugins screen like any other update.

How do I add news items?

You can type them in manually (title + URL) or use the “Load from posts” picker to pull content from any post type, filtered by taxonomy, terms, or keyword. Loaded items are frozen as snapshots, so they do not update on their own.

Will it slow down my site?

No. By default the plugin only loads its CSS and JS on pages that actually contain a ticker. You can switch to global loading from Settings if you prefer.

Are Google Fonts GDPR-compliant?

Yes. When you save a ticker with a Google Font selected, the plugin downloads that font variant to your server. Visitors’ browsers load the font from your own domain, and no request is ever made to Google at runtime.

Can I override the ticker template from my theme?

Yes. Copy templates/ticker.php from the plugin into your active theme’s root and WordPress will use your copy instead.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Premium is now a real product. Licenses are handled from your WordPress admin: activate a key, move it to another site, and receive updates of the Premium version automatically. Every plan unlocks the same features and differs only in how many sites one license covers.
  • Dynamic items (Premium): add a WP Query as an item and it stays live. The ticker stores the search instead of freezing the posts it finds, so a new post appears on its own. The editor counts how many posts the query matches right now and lets you see them, and it says so plainly when the answer is none.
  • Item scheduling (Premium): a clock on the item row opens “from” and “until”, both optional, both inclusive, each with an optional time of day. A scheduled item adds one thin line naming its state (running, upcoming, past) and its dates.
  • Three Premium themes, each with a texture of its own tinted from the palette: Comic (impact rays, halftone and a skewed label), Capsule (one soft fully rounded bar with a lit rim) and Galaxy (nebula filaments and stars).
  • Seven Premium palettes with soft gradients: Forest, Sunset, Blossom, Cobalt, Graphite, Gold and Neon. Thirteen palettes in total, plus the custom one, which stays free.
  • Twenty-two icons (Premium) that can take the place of the label’s pulse dot.
  • Elementor widget and Oxygen Builder element (Premium), both under the Oxypage category. Divi, Beaver Builder and Bricks are listed as coming soon.
  • Rebuilt “My Tickers” list: every row shows a live miniature of the ticker with its own theme, palette, label and first headline, next to its item count, its shortcode and an on/off switch. Tickers that are switched off are greyed out. The publication date column is hidden by default and can be brought back from Screen Options.
  • New color fields that accept anything CSS does: hex, named colors, rgb()/rgba() and hsl()/hsla(), in the old comma syntax or the modern one.
  • A “Display date” button on each item, so the date the visitor reads is never confused with the scheduling window.
  • Dynamic items stay fresh on sites with a page cache: the ticker checks its own age in the browser and refreshes only when the page it arrived in is stale.
  • The default tag text is now “News”, and a ticker’s description is shown under its name in the list.

1.1.1

  • Small fixes to how the admin buttons are displayed: icons and labels are now properly aligned, and the buttons in the page header line up with each other.
  • Support and suggestions now go to support@oxypage.com, with the subject prefilled.
  • The Breaking News Ticker block now runs in the iframed block editor, so the editor no longer falls back to its older rendering mode because of it.
  • Now requires WordPress 6.7 or later, which loads the bundled translations on its own.

1.1.0

  • Now you can deploy your tickers using a Gutenberg Block.
  • New movement modes: Fade and Continuous.
  • New Minimalist theme.
  • Optional date per ticker item.
  • Palettes now have a dark and a light mode, switchable per ticker.
  • Custom palettes with gradients are now free.
  • Optional per-headline pulse dot and edge fade.
  • New Premium fields: per-ticker description, rel attribute, and item display limit.
  • JSON import / export of tickers from the “My Tickers” screen.
  • Spanish (es_ES) translation and .pot template.
  • Softer admin buttons; palette cards mirror the real ticker layout.
  • Removed the “Decoration (arrow)” color; the arrow follows the label color.
  • Fixed: Google fonts chosen for the label were not self-hosted at save time.
  • Editor fixes: shortcode shown only after saving, working copy button.

1.0.0

  • Ticker CPT with tabbed editor: Content, Behavior, and Style.
  • Manual items with drag-and-drop reordering, plus a “Load from posts” snapshot picker.
  • Behavior controls: direction, speed, easing, autoplay, loop, offset, and pause options.
  • Three structural themes and six color palettes.
  • Independent typography for news text and label; Google Fonts self-hosted at save time.
  • Visibility toggles for prev/next buttons, play-pause, pulse dot, and label.
  • Link options: open in new tab and rel attribute.
  • Shortcode [oxpbnt_ticker id=”X”] with one-click copy and AJAX activation toggle.
  • Freemium: up to 3 tickers with 20 items each in the free plan.
  • Smart asset loading and optional clean uninstall.
